decision_skill.name: validated_seasonal_baseline
decision_skill.description: Prefer a simple library-based seasonal baseline when repeated cycles support stable phase-aligned behavior and no verified evidence justifies an intervention.
decision_skill.applicability: When the series exhibits recurring seasonal structure and candidate forecasts can be compared using recent rolling validation.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Select the lowest-error robust candidate on recent rolling absolute-error evaluations; retain the phase-aligned seasonal baseline unless a trend or lag-adjusted alternative demonstrates a consistent improvement.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when seasonality is unstable, structural change is verified, phase-aligned history is unavailable, or validation does not reliably distinguish candidates.
